II. Latitudinal position
III. Long hours of sunshine
IV. High temperature disparity

official_questions.core_fact: Tropical India (Maharashtra, Karnataka, TN, AP) gives higher cane yield and recovery due to latitude, longer sunshine, long growing season, low temperature disparity and cool clear nights at ripening.

official_questions.rule: Tropical cane: higher yield/sucrose; sub-tropical (UP) larger area; equable temperature favours cane.

Consider the following statements with reference to Vande Bharat Express :

official_questions.rule: Speeds: Vande Bharat 160-180 (semi-high); Gatimaan 160; MAHSR bullet train 320.

official_questions.stem:
Tourism in India has turned out to be a key service sub-sector. Which of the following statements are valid regarding the Tourism sector in India ?
I. NIDHI is a technology-driven system meant for providing services to Hospitality and Travel industry.
II. The Government has resolved to make India a one trillion USD tourism economy by 2047 with 100 million international investors.
III. The Hotel Occupancy Rate has been rapidly increasing alongside a consistent rise in the average daily rate and revenue per available room.
IV. India's Services Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) has been in the expanding zone.
Select the correct answer using the codes given below :
official_questions.core_fact: NIDHI is the Tourism Ministry's hospitality database; vision of a USD 1 trillion tourism economy by 2047 (with ~100 million foreign tourist arrivals); services PMI above 50.

statements.t: NIDHI is a technology-driven system meant for providing services to Hospitality and Travel industry.
The Government has resolved to make India a one trillion USD tourism economy by 2047 with 100 million international investors.
The Hotel Occupancy Rate has been rapidly increasing alongside a consistent rise in the average daily rate and revenue per available room.
statements.fact: Per the key, hotel occupancy did not rise rapidly and consistently alongside ADR/RevPAR as claimed.

statements.t: India's Services Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) has been in the expanding zone.

official_questions.rule: Tourism: NIDHI = hospitality database; Vision 2047 = $1 trillion; PMI > 50 = expansion.
official_questions.key_note: Statement II says '100 million international investors'; the official target is ~100 million foreign tourist arrivals. Key keeps II as valid.
